title: Correct guidance needed to prevent Sri Lanka becoming “Climate Orphans” – CEJ
summary: The Centre for Environmental Justice (CEJ) has called for urgent action to strengthen climate resilience and environmental management in Sri Lanka, warning that the country risks becoming “climate orphans” if proper guidance and adaptation measures are not implemented.

title: IPL fireball: Here comes the sun…
summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi who last week was declared as the Indian Premier League’s (IPL) most valuable player, arrived in Sri Lanka today with the India A team to contest a Triangular series that will also feature Afghanistan in Dambulla.

title: Sri Lanka launches EU-backed green reporting guidelines
summary: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake today launched revised green reporting guidelines to align local public and private sectors with international sustainability standards.

title: Trinity’s spirit too much for worn out Wesley
summary: Trinity outclassed Wesley by 43 points to 10 in their Cup segment match of the Dialog Schools Rugby league tournament played at Havelock Park. It turned out to a one-sided affair as the Lions dominated proceedings and had things their own way.

title: CSE ends week on a soft note as early gains fade amid cautious Friday profit-taking
summary: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) ended the week on a slightly weaker footing on Friday, as an early attempt at recovery lost momentum and the market drifted lower into the close. Despite a positive start to the session, profit-taking and selective selling during the latter half of trading erased intraday gains, resulting in a marginally negative finish.

title: Massive raid nets 19 firearms, Ice and 100,000 pregabalin pills
summary: Police have seized 19 firearms, T-56 ammunition, crystal methamphetamine (Ice), and more than 100,000 Pregabalin pills following a two-week investigation that uncovered a suspected drug and weapons trafficking network operating between the Southern and Western provinces.

title: Wrong decisions led to rupee devaluation crisis - Mujibur
summary: Wrong decisions have led to the current rupee devaluation crisis, a Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) MP said today.

title: Sangakkara Joins Women Cricketers’ Transformation Meeting
summary: Players of the National Team, Sri Lanka ‘A’, and Under-19 teams participated in the meeting, which was chaired by Eran Wickramaratne, Chairman of the Cricket Transformation Committee.

title: Gimhani ruled out of Women’s T20 World Cup; Vimukthi called up
summary: Sri Lanka have suffered an injury setback ahead of the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup 2026, with Shashini Gimhani ruled out of the tournament after sustaining a lower-back injury during training.

title: Suspected Ebola case reported in India
summary: A suspected case of Ebola virus disease has been reported in Rajasthan, prompting health authorities to activate precautionary protocols while awaiting laboratory confirmation. The patient, a woman from Uganda who arrived in Jaipur from Sharjah on Friday morning aboard an Air Arabia flight, was flagged during routine airport screening after exhibiting symptoms consistent with Ebola virus disease.

title: FCID arrests Wimal’s ex-media secretary
summary: Former Media Secretary to Wimal Weerawansa, Prasad Manju, has been arrested by the Financial Crimes Investigation Division (FCID) in connection with an investigation into the alleged misuse of state resources, Police said.

title: Rupee depreciation not an economic crisis, says Deputy Finance Minister
summary: Deputy Minister of Finance and Planning Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando has dismissed claims that the recent depreciation of the Sri Lankan rupee signals an economic crisis, describing such portrayals as misleading.

title: US Senate approves US$70 billion for Trump immigration crackdown
summary: The US Senate on Friday (Jun 5) approved US$70 billion in funding for Donald Trump’s hardline immigration crackdown, but only after a long day of votes on multiple amendments that highlighted Republican infighting over some of the president’s other contentious policy proposals.

title: LAUGFS gas prices remain unchanged
summary: LAUGFS Gas PLC has announced that domestic LPG prices will remain unchanged for June despite rising global procurement costs, supply chain challenges, and the depreciation of the Sri Lankan rupee.

title: Police hunt three suspects in Meegoda fatal crash
summary: Police have sought public assistance to locate and arrest three suspects who allegedly fled the scene of the fatal road accident near the Meegoda Junction on the Avissawella-Colombo High Level Road, which claimed six lives and left seven others critically injured.
